title: Jean K Other21827 NDE 21827
content: We always went to my Mother's and help prepare holiday dinner. I was standing against the door going into the kitchen, just talking and laughing with everyone in the kitchen. I saw myself on the other side of the room sitting on the steps, peeling potatoes and talking and laughing, but I could not hear what I was saying and all I could do was point at myself. Of course, everyone laughed and said yea right, but I could not explain it. I didn't know why or how. Only how strange I felt at the time. Everyone laughed it off and I though no more about it until about hour later. I was actually sitting on the steps peeling potatoes, and it was as if I felt a shock, jolt and I realized that where I was, what I had seen an hour earlier. It just happened.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No Happiness Holiday at my families house and we were preparing dinner
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Vision of the future
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future I didn't know until later when I realized where I was and was like shocked. It was just the wired feeling.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I always felt as if I'm a round peg trying to fit in a square hole.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I always felt as if I'm a round peg trying to fit in a square hole. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The feeling was like elation, absence, disbelief and an ‘Oh my god!’ How could I see myself on the other side of a room, doing something completing different that was I was currently doing.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I knew in July that our dog would die Christmas morning. I was washing dishes and she ran by the window and when I saw her I knew, I actually said ‘God you wouldn't take the dog and on Christmas morning. She died Christmas morning of a heart attack in my husband arms at the vet's office.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The only down was the disbelief of others.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: It is a good questionnaire, it just that there is no way to prove an out of body experience until, you can bring something back with you, and something tells me that is possible, I just don't know how yet.
